# Will

> Marks in a file say what an agent may edit, append to, or leave unchanged. A guard checks edits before the host writes.

Keep Will marks and `keep` text unchanged; add only at the end of `append`. Unmarked text is editable. Unreadable marks keep the whole file. Intent grants no authority.

- [Standard and setup](README.md): Markdown and text bindings, laws, and host responsibilities.
- [Write guard](guard.mjs): compare proposed bytes or exact splices against the original.
- [Git check](git-check.mjs): `node git-check.mjs staged` or `node git-check.mjs pr BASE [HEAD]`.
- [Claude Code hook](claude-hook.json): veto Write and Edit through a trusted installation.
- [Sealed passages](approval.mjs): list seal integrity by file and region; no identity or permission claim.
- [Reference](will.mjs): parse, evaluate, compare, seal, verify, and strip. `node will.mjs strip source.md > public.md` removes marks from a publishing copy.
- [Vectors](vectors.json): `node will.mjs check vectors.json` checks the JavaScript reference. Python and Go check the Markdown cases.
